page.overview:
Who is Milt Fankhouser?

Milt Fankhouser (born 29 October 1915 and died 26 February 1970) was an American racing driver who participated in the Indianapolis 500 between 1947 and 1950. He only managed to qualify for the 1947 event, although he completed only two laps before his car stalled.
